name: Devourer

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devourer makes two Claw attacks and uses Imprison Soul if it has a creature grappled.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Imprison Soul
entries: The devourer chooses a living humanoid with 0 hit points that it is grappling. That creature is teleported inside the devourer's ribcage and imprisoned there. While imprisoned, the target has disadvantage on death saves. If it dies, the devourer regains 25 hit points and immediately recharges Soul Rend.

action.name: Soul Rend {@recharge 6}
entries: The devourer creates a vortex of life-draining energy in a 20-foot radius. Each humanoid in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

fluffEntries: **Devourers de Osybus:** carcaças invocadas pelo culto como guardiões do corredor. Resgatar um aliado preso exige derrotar o Devourer — a alma liberta cai nas costelas partidas, com 1 PV.
